subject.title: fix(qa-channel): honor canonical thread action fields

question: Should the published QA-channel adapter permanently resolve conflicting action parameters by preferring canonical `target`, `threadName`, and `message` values over its legacy aliases?
rationale: The technical fix is narrow and preserves aliases, but conflict precedence defines the durable behavior of a released public adapter surface rather than a purely mechanical bug repair.

options.title: Confirm canonical-first precedence
options.body: Accept the proposed shared-contract behavior so canonical fields win whenever callers provide both canonical and legacy forms.

options.title: Retain legacy-first conflicts
options.body: Ask for a focused revision that preserves legacy values when both forms are present, while still accepting canonical-only calls.

recommendation.title: Confirm canonical-first precedence
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed shared-contract behavior so canonical fields win whenever callers provide both canonical and legacy forms.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision belongs with the person or group responsible for the released QA-channel adapter contract; the available evidence cannot safely identify a specific historical owner.
